fasterenergy.ponder.alternator.text_1: The Alternator converts rotational force into FE.
fasterenergy.ponder.alternator.text_2: It will give FE to any blocks placed next to it.
fasterenergy.ponder.alternator.text_3: Its input speed must meet the minimum RPM for it to start generating FE.
fasterenergy.ponder.alternator.text_4: It becomes less efficient when the input RPM is fast, but generates more FE.
